args: Implement docs/plans/one-city-one-truth-plan.md using existing data only: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 make "What applies today" true at city level (apply amendments to tables and provisions so only current rules and current wording show as governing, replaced rules move to "Older or replaced rules", duplicates shown once, overlap and band continuity checks in CI with current-text overlaps shown plainly as not settled, "Replaced" labels only on real replacements and never on bye-law 1.4, governing lists free of definitions and tables of contents); Part 2 build shared rules once for Greater Bengaluru and make each City Corporation a thin layer that marks only its own differences, with all five corporations' 2026 amendments passing the fidelity and structure checks and a parity check in CI; Part 3 remove every page in the old design, rebuild corporation pages from the Bylaw One templates, redirect all old addresses, and add an old-design check in CI; Part 4 state the land-use zone gap plainly on the map and Land use page; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
